tickets.text: Position system (C26): W close_vs_swing_high_pct 20.92 is the resistance break already in; D close_vs_swing_high_pct -4.96 is a pause, not a wait for a new base. Entry trade_above:bar_high on D, trailed to each new prior-day high (C27), no base or volume gate (C19). Wrong if a daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), or a red candle then a trade under its low (C14, C29).
